title: Symthaea-Symtropy paired robotics recovery scenarios

expansion.determinism_requirement: Each key yields the same initial state, task, and exogenous fault schedule for every arm.

fault_families.purpose: Exercise stale and unavailable observations against declared freshness limits.
fault_families.expected_boundary: Expired or missing required evidence must not be treated as fresh; behavior depends on frozen policy and should fail closed when required evidence cannot be established.

fault_families.purpose: Exercise delayed and dropped requests/acknowledgements at the controller boundary.
fault_families.expected_boundary: Lease is rechecked at actual enqueue/application; expired requests are not submitted.

fault_families.purpose: Exercise recovery with reduced, bounded native actuator authority while retaining the local safety controller.
fault_families.expected_boundary: Never compensate for degradation by bypassing native limits; unsafe actuation is a hard failure.

fault_families.purpose: Exercise replanning after an obstacle or feasible-goal change.
fault_families.expected_boundary: The cognitive policy may not consume information before its declared visibility tick; path feasibility remains a separate planner/controller responsibility.

fault_families.purpose: Exercise lifecycle integrity under duplicate, delayed, reordered, and post-terminal events.
fault_families.expected_boundary: Wrong-ticket, invalid ordering, and post-terminal events must be rejected without mutating last accepted state.

fault_families.purpose: Exercise restart fencing and old event rejection around a controller/session epoch change.
fault_families.expected_boundary: Old-session/old-ticket outcomes must not be treated as current after restart, including when native ticket strings are reused. The integration must use an authoritative, restart-safe monotonic controller generation; missing, rolled-back, or unavailable generation evidence fails closed. If durable epoch/rekey support is absent, report capability not implemented and fail the corresponding gate.

preregistration_rules: Freeze numeric profile values and all injection ticks before scored runs.
Do not silently replace seeds, omit failures, or change scenario expansion after viewing arm results.
The same scenario identity is paired across all arms.
Any simulator crash, timeout, unresolved lifecycle, or missing raw record is explicitly represented.
Mock/simulation results do not qualify HIL or physical safety.
